meta.name: seo-images
meta.description: Image optimization analysis for SEO and performance. Checks alt text, file sizes, formats, responsive images, lazy loading, CLS prevention, image SERP rankings (via DataForSEO), and image file optimization (WebP/AVIF conversion, IPTC/XMP metadata injection). Use when user says "image optimization", "alt text", "image SEO", "image size", "image audit", "optimize images", "image metadata", "image SERP", "convert to webp", or "image file optimize".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 优化图片提升搜索引擎排名与加载速度
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果负责网站图片的SEO优化与性能提升
copy.tagline_en: Optimize images to boost search rankings and page speed
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage image SEO and performance for your website

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会分析网页图片的替代文本、文件大小、格式、响应式图片、懒加载、布局偏移预防，并可通过 DataForSEO 查询图片在 Google 图片搜索中的排名，还能转换图片格式并注入元数据。
howto.when: 当你提到“图片优化”、“替代文本”、“图片SEO”、“图片大小”、“图片审计”、“优化图片”、“图片元数据”、“图片SERP”、“转换为WebP”或“图片文件优化”等关键词时。

say.text: 分析这个网页的图片SEO问题。
say.note: Claude 会执行完整图片审计。

say.text: 把这张图片转换成WebP格式并添加版权元数据。
say.note: Claude 会调用图片文件优化功能。

say.text: 查询关键词“蓝色跑鞋”的图片SERP排名。
say.note: Claude 会使用 DataForSEO 分析图片排名。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude analyzes webpage images for alt text, file size, format, responsive images, lazy loading, CLS prevention, and can query Google Images SERP rankings via DataForSEO, as well as convert image formats and inject metadata.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "image optimization", "alt text", "image SEO", "image size", "image audit", "optimize images", "image metadata", "image SERP", "convert to webp", or "image file optimize".

say_en.text: Analyze the image SEO issues on this page.
say_en.note: Claude will perform a full image audit.

say_en.text: Convert this image to WebP and add copyright metadata.
say_en.note: Claude will run image file optimization.

say_en.text: Query image SERP rankings for keyword 'blue running shoes'.
say_en.note: Claude will use DataForSEO to analyze image rankings.
